purpose: Test whether the frozen Adelie roster supports a same-sensor Landsat-7 ETM+ occupied-footprint comparison, avoiding ETM+ to OLI classifier transfer as the primary route.

landsat.product_role: Level-1 ETM+ imagery from which TOA reflectance compatible with the recovered published classifier can be derived

early_slc_on.rationale: Published ETM+ classifier era before the 31 May 2003 SLC failure.

late_slc_off.rationale: Same ETM+ sensor before Landsat 7 left the nominal WRS-2 orbit in April 2022; SLC-off gaps must be handled as missing pixels rather than filled from demographic-favorable scenes.

slc_off_rule.catalog_stage: Do not treat SLC-off as a failure at scene-metadata stage.
slc_off_rule.pixel_stage: Require a separately frozen paired-pixel support rule using multiple late ETM+ acquisitions; scan gaps are missing data, not negative guano classifications.

decision.primary_route_if_supported: Validate the published ETM+ classifier numerically, then estimate early versus late occupied-footprint change using ETM+ only.
decision.fallback_if_unsupported: Return to a separately validated ETM+ to OLI spectral bridge; do not switch after seeing demographic outcomes.

stop_rule: Do not change epochs, platform, seasonal months, cloud thresholds, or minimum scene/year counts after demographic outcomes are joined.
